name: Cybernetic Seduction
source:
A thrilling story where highly-skilled agents enter the simulation to pull off a grand scam. Your Target? Hector Zhine.
Make connections in the New Zhine City to infiltrate his criminal empire. As a Cock - an agent whose sole responsibility is to seduce women around the Target - you have the ability to penetrate Zhine's inner circle. With each member demanding a distinct approach, seduction alone won't get the job done. Be trustworthy, reliable, resourceful to charm your way into Zhine's family hearts. Convince his assistant and his employees that you are the answer to all their needs and desires.

The closer you get to the top, the more dangerous the mission becomes, as the simulation's alerted security system always watches.
Good luck, Agent!
​
[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/1thousand]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
这是一个惊心动魄的故事，高超的特工进入模拟环境，实施一场大骗局。你的目标？赫克托·日内.
在新日恩城建立联系，渗透到他的犯罪帝国。作为一名Cock特工，其唯一职责就是引诱目标周围的女性，你有能力渗透Zine的核心圈子。由于每个成员都要求采取独特的方法，仅靠诱惑是无法完成任务的。值得信赖、可靠、足智多谋，才能赢得Zhne家人的青睐。让他的助手和员工相信你是他们所有需求和愿望的答案。

你越接近山顶，任务就越危险，因为模拟的警报安全系统始终在监视。
祝你好运，特工！
​
[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/1thousand]Patreon[/url]]
